# CORD expense smoke fixture licence

Kind: reference.

The six receipt images `R01.png` to `R06.png` come from the
[naver-clova-ix/cord-v2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/naver-clova-ix/cord-v2)
dataset, validation split, revision
`7f0115a4b758a71d6473b8d085751692da2fef98`. The images are not modified.

The dataset is licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Attribution: Park, S., Shin, S., Lee, B., Lee, J., Surh, J., Seo, M. and
Lee, H. "CORD: A Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing."
Document Intelligence Workshop at NeurIPS 2019. NAVER Clova.

`manifest.json` copies the annotated `total_price` of each row. The claims in
`manifest.json` are synthetic test data written for typevet issue #163. They
are not part of CORD.
